content.body:
Installed dmmulroy/anti-slop into effect-port only (root's separate anti-slop install at tools/oxlint/anti-slop, pinned e8c4880471b23ab7f216fba7b27d173a6ef07d4c, is untouched).

Upstream: fetched a fresh clone of https://github.com/dmmulroy/anti-slop (not the possibly-stale bundled .claude skill) and inspected HEAD directly. Pinned commit c44ef22ca116d0ba62a3ff663a0bd13a3f3fa40b (merge of PR #36 'contrib/effect-tag-match-rules', 2026-09-10T09:53:24-04:00). Verified src/ and skills/install-anti-slop/assets/anti-slop/ were byte-identical (excluding *.test.ts) at that commit before vendoring, then vendored via upstream's own skills/install-anti-slop/scripts/install.mjs into effect-port/tools/oxlint/anti-slop/. This upstream revision is newer than the locally bundled .claude/skills/install-anti-slop assets and adds require-readable-spacing plus 4 Effect rules (no-manual-effect-error-tag, no-manual-tag-comparison, no-manual-tagged-construction, prefer-effect-match) beyond what that bundle had.

Provenance: recorded in effect-port/tools/oxlint/anti-slop/UPSTREAM.md (source, exact commit, installed plugin paths, dependency rationale). MIT LICENSE copied to tools/oxlint/anti-slop/LICENSE; nested vendor/eslint-stylistic/ keeps its own LICENSE and UPSTREAM.md as shipped upstream.

Dependencies: effect-port had no prior oxlint dependency, so per the bundled skill's fresh-install step, queried `npm view oxlint version` / `npm view @oxlint/plugins version` (both 1.82.0) and installed both as exact devDependencies via `bun add -D oxlint@1.82.0 @oxlint/plugins@1.82.0` (matches the root repo's own pin). Pre-existing pinned effect@4.0.0-rc.112, typescript@7.0.2, @effect/tsgo@0.43.0, and the existing prepare/check/test/effect:diagnostics/toolchain:check scripts are all unchanged (verified by reading package.json immediately before editing). Added two new scripts: `lint` (oxlint src tests scripts) and `lint:anti-slop-smoke` (node scripts/anti-slop-smoke.mjs). bun.lock updated additively (oxlint + @oxlint/plugins + their platform-optional bindings only).

Configuration: effect-port/oxlint.config.ts registers both the generic `anti-slop` plugin and the opt-in `anti-slop-effect` plugin (enabled because package.json declares `effect` as a direct dependency), using the exact canonical ignorePatterns/jsPlugins/rules from upstream's README/skill at the pinned commit, with no rule disabled or downgraded. 18 generic rules + oxc/no-accumulating-spread, and all 5 Effect rules, are enabled at "error".

Lint (honest, not cleaned up): `bun run lint` (= `oxlint src tests scripts`) exits 1 with 2930 errors and 12 warnings across effect-port's existing application src/tests/scripts (full output in evidence/anti-slop-lint.txt; per-rule counts in evidence/anti-slop-lint-rule-breakdown.txt). Dominant rule: anti-slop(require-readable-spacing) at 2736 hits (blank-line formatting), followed by require-safety-comment-for-type-assertion (61), no-runtime-typeof (44), no-unknown-parameters (43), and the Effect rule anti-slop-effect(no-manual-tag-comparison) at 21 hits plus anti-slop-effect(prefer-effect-match) at 5 hits — both real Effect architecture findings in the current port. No rule was suppressed or weakened to hide these; per the brief, application cleanup is left to the lead (already flagged on board thread 'Effect port integration coordination'). This lint snapshot reflects a live, concurrently-edited tree (five workers + lead editing src/tests in parallel), so exact counts will drift between runs; the evidence file is the honest snapshot at completion time.

Smoke test: effect-port/scripts/anti-slop-smoke.mjs (run via `bun run lint:anti-slop-smoke`) writes two fixtures under the git-ignored .test-output/anti-slop-smoke/ directory and lints each individually: violation.ts (state._tag === "Ready") must exit 1 with an anti-slop-effect(no-manual-tag-comparison) finding, and corrected.ts (Predicate.isTagged("Ready")(state)) must exit 0 with zero anti-slop findings. Both assertions passed on the final run (evidence/anti-slop-smoke.txt); the script exits non-zero if either expectation is not met, so it cannot silently report success.

Typecheck: `bun run check` (tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json, pre-existing script, untouched) currently exits 1 due to pre-existing @effect/language-service `preferTypedSchemaDecoder` suggestions in tests/ (evidence/anti-slop-typecheck.txt). These are unrelated to this anti-slop installation: none of the changed files (oxlint.config.ts, package.json, bun.lock, tools/oxlint/anti-slop/**, scripts/anti-slop-smoke.mjs, docs/anti-slop.md, evidence/anti-slop*) are included by tsconfig.json's `src/**/*.ts`/`tests/**/*.ts` globs, and this is existing diagnostics tooling explicitly out of scope to touch. Reporting as-is, not fixing.

Scope discipline: only files under the brief's ownership list were created or modified (verified via `git status --porcelain` before and after — root-level diffs are unchanged and attributable to concurrent workers, not this attempt). No application source, existing tests, tsconfig, or root files were edited. No commit, push, publish, or merge was performed.

Blockers: none. No dependency conflicts arose (oxlint 1.82.0 pair coexists cleanly with TypeScript 7.0.2 / @effect/tsgo 0.43.0; `effect-tsgo patch --typescript --no-oxlint` in `prepare` still ran and skipped the typescript patch as a no-op hash match).

evidenceClaims: Only the brief's owned paths under effect-port/ were created or changed; no application source, tests, tsconfig, diagnostics tooling, or root files were touched, and nothing was committed.
Running the real lint over effect-port's existing src/tests/scripts produces 2930 errors and 12 warnings, reported honestly and not suppressed.
The anti-slop-smoke.mjs script proves the Effect no-manual-tag-comparison rule rejects a deliberate violation fixture and accepts the corresponding corrected fixture, both under .test-output.
The generic and Effect anti-slop Oxlint plugins are vendored and registered in effect-port/oxlint.config.ts with every applicable rule enabled at error, none disabled.
Upstream anti-slop was fetched fresh from GitHub and pinned to commit c44ef22ca116d0ba62a3ff663a0bd13a3f3fa40b, verified to match its own bundled skill assets at that commit.
oxlint and @oxlint/plugins are pinned to the same exact version (1.82.0) in effect-port/package.json devDependencies; all previously pinned dependencies and scripts are preserved.
